statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea
There is clinical suspicion for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
A 30-day cardiac event monitor (CPT 93271) is ordered
The service is to capture and characterize arrhythmic events for definitive diagnosis and management planning
The diagnosis codes are I49.9 and I48.91
The denial reason code is CO-97
Less intensive monitoring options were attempted and deemed insufficient prior to initiating this level of care
